info.title: x402 Carbon Retirement API
info.description: Retire tokenized carbon credits on Base through Klima Protocol and the Carbonmark marketplace, and resolve the public Carbonmark certificate. Discovery, quotes and certificates are free. Retiring is paid: each retirement costs the credit price plus a fee, sent from your own wallet (GET /api/prepare/retire) or funded by a signed authorization and relayed non-custodially (POST /api/actions/retire, which adds executor gas). GET /api/catalog is a $0.001 x402 snapshot of the most liquid supply.
info.x-guidance: Base mainnet (chainId 8453). Paid ($0.001, standard x402 exact USDC): GET /api/catalog returns the most liquid supply with links to the flow below. Free: GET /api/discover lists all supply (retire by `carbonClass` or `listingId`); GET /api/quote prices it. Self-submitted: GET /api/prepare/retire returns an [approve, retire] batch to send from your wallet. Relayed (x402): GET /api/prepare-auth returns typedData, sign it exactly as returned, then POST `actionsRetireRequest` to /api/actions/retire with `authPayload.signature` set. GET /api/certificate?txHash= resolves the certificate. Error codes and remedies: /.well-known/x402-errors.json.

get.summary: API entry point: endpoints and top supply snapshot (paid, $0.001)
get.description: Entry point to the x402 Carbon Retirement API on Base. Returns every endpoint you need plus a live snapshot of the top 3 carbon classes and marketplace listings by liquidity. Discover, quote and certificate are free. Retiring is paid: each retirement costs the credit price plus a fee, sent from your own wallet (prepare/retire) or relayed from a signed USDC authorization (prepare-auth + POST actions/retire). Full spec at /openapi.json. Paid per call with a standard x402 v2 `exact` USDC payment on Base, settled by the Coinbase facilitator. GET /api/discover returns the full catalog for free.

402.description: Payment Required. The x402 v2 challenge is in the `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header (base64 JSON). Pay in USDC on Base (eip155:8453) with the `exact` scheme and retry with the `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header.

503.description: `error` is one of: payment_unavailable. Meaning and remedy per code: /.well-known/x402-errors.json

get.summary: List retirable carbon credits with live prices
get.description: Use to find carbon supply to retire on Base. Returns `carbonClasses[]` (pooled protocol supply, retire by `carbonClass`) and `marketplaceListings[]` (a seller's fixed ask, retire by `listingId`), each with USDC-per-tonne prices, liquidity and project metadata. Filters are AND-combined. Free.

get.summary: Build the authorization to sign for a relayed retirement
get.description: Use to pay for a retirement without sending a transaction. Returns EIP-712 `typedData` (EIP-3009 for USDC, EIP-2612 permit for kVCM) and a ready-to-send `actionsRetireRequest`. Sign `typedData` exactly as returned, set `authPayload.signature`, and POST the request to /api/actions/retire. Requires `details.beneficiaryAddress` or `beneficiaryIsPayer=true`. Paid: the signed authorization funds the retirement, costing the credit price plus a fee and executor gas.

post.summary: Retire carbon credits, paid with a signed x402 authorization
post.description: Use to retire carbon credits and receive the Carbonmark certificate in one call. Non-custodial: the payer's signed USDC (EIP-3009) or kVCM (EIP-2612) authorization funds the settlement contract directly, and the service only relays it. POST without `authPayload` to receive the 402 challenge; POST again with the signature in `authPayload`, posting `actionsRetireRequest` verbatim (including `salt`). Cost is the retirement price + fee + executor gas, all inside the signed budget; any unspent budget is refunded in the same transaction.

200.description: Retirement settled (or confirmed and awaiting indexing: `status: pending_index`).
